title: Type confusion in PostgreSQL operator commutator and negator links allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code…
description: A type confusion vulnerability in PostgreSQL operator commutator and negator links allows an object creator with privileges to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database. This occurs via linking operators that have different result types or by creating inconsistent reciprocal links. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
